title: Placement Test
description: Проверяет грамматику, словарный запас, чтение и восприятие на слух от уровня A1 до B1. Займёт около 25 минут; задания идут от простых к сложным.

exercises.q: My sister ___ a teacher.
exercises.explain: С he/she/it и единственным числом глагол be имеет форму is.

exercises.q: ___ you like coffee?
exercises.explain: Вопрос в Present Simple с you строится через do.

exercises.q: There ___ (be) two cats in the garden.
exercises.explain: Со множественным числом (two cats) используется there are.

exercises.q: He ___ to work every day.
exercises.explain: В Present Simple с he/she/it к глаголу добавляется -s/-es: goes.

exercises.q: Look! The children ___ in the park.
exercises.explain: Look! указывает на действие прямо сейчас — нужен Present Continuous.

exercises.q: I ___ (not / like) fish.
exercises.explain: Отрицание в Present Simple с I: don't + глагол.

exercises.q: We ___ to the cinema last night.
exercises.explain: Last night — прошлое время, go во второй форме — went.

exercises.q: ___ did you go on holiday? — To Spain.
exercises.explain: Ответ «в Испанию» отвечает на вопрос «куда» — where.

exercises.q: This book is ___ than that one.
exercises.explain: Длинные прилагательные образуют сравнительную степень с more.

exercises.q: I'm going ___ my grandmother tomorrow.
exercises.explain: Конструкция be going to + глагол выражает планы.

exercises.q: She ___ (not / go) to school yesterday because she was ill.
exercises.explain: Отрицание в Past Simple: didn't + начальная форма глагола.

exercises.q: Have you ever ___ to London?
exercises.explain: В Present Perfect нужна третья форма: have been.

exercises.q: You ___ wear a seatbelt in a car. It's the law.
exercises.explain: Must выражает обязанность, например по закону.

exercises.q: I ___ (live) here since 2015.
exercises.explain: С since для действия, которое продолжается до сих пор, нужен Present Perfect.

exercises.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
exercises.explain: Первое условное: if + Present Simple, will + глагол.

exercises.q: When the phone rang, I ___ a shower.
exercises.explain: Длительное действие в прошлом, которое прервали, — Past Continuous.

exercises.q: This bridge ___ (build) in 1890.
exercises.explain: Пассив в прошедшем времени: was/were + третья форма.

exercises.q: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
exercises.explain: Для людей в придаточных используется who.

exercises.q: If I ___ more money, I would buy a car.
exercises.explain: Второе условное: if + Past Simple, would + глагол.

exercises.q: By the time we got to the station, the train ___ (leave).
exercises.explain: Действие, случившееся раньше другого прошлого действия, — Past Perfect.

exercises.q: The opposite of «cheap» is ___.
exercises.explain: Cheap — дешёвый, противоположное — expensive (дорогой).

exercises.q: My father's sister is my ___.
exercises.explain: Сестра отца или матери — aunt (тётя).

exercises.q: Can you ___ me the time, please?
exercises.explain: Устойчивое выражение: tell somebody the time.

exercises.q: Please ___ the light; it's dark in here.
exercises.explain: Turn on — включить; в темноте свет нужно включить.

exercises.q: I'm very ___ (interest) in history; I read a lot about it.
exercises.explain: О чувствах человека говорят прилагательным на -ed: interested in.

exercises.q: We missed the bus, so we had to ___ a taxi.
exercises.explain: По-английски говорят take a taxi.

exercises.q: Can you ___ my bag while I go to the toilet?
exercises.explain: Look after — присматривать за кем-то или чем-то.

exercises.q: The film was really ___ (bore); I fell asleep.
exercises.explain: О том, что вызывает скуку, говорят прилагательным на -ing: boring.

exercises.q: I have ___ my keys. I can't find them anywhere.
exercises.explain: Lose — потерять вещь; miss — пропустить, скучать.

exercises.q: The concert was ___ because of the bad weather.
exercises.explain: Cancel — отменить мероприятие.

sections.title: Чтение
sections.text:
Last year, Elena moved from a small village to Manchester to study at university. At first, life in the big city was difficult. She didn't know anybody, and the streets were always noisy and full of people. She missed her family and her dog, Bruno.

In her first month, Elena joined the university photography club. Every Saturday the members walked around the city and took pictures of old buildings, markets and parks. Elena soon made two good friends there, Priya and Jack.

Now Elena loves Manchester. She has a part-time job in a café near the station, and she goes home to the village only once a month. 'I was nervous when I arrived,' she says, 'but moving here was the best decision of my life. Next year I want to organise a photography exhibition with my friends.'

exercises.q: Elena grew up in a big city.
exercises.explain: Елена переехала в Манчестер из маленькой деревни.

exercises.q: Why was life difficult for Elena at first?
exercises.explain: В тексте: She didn't know anybody.

exercises.q: What did the club members do on Saturdays?
options: They took photos around the city.
exercises.explain: Члены клуба гуляли по городу и фотографировали здания, рынки и парки.

exercises.q: Elena visits her village every weekend.
exercises.explain: Она ездит домой только раз в месяц (once a month).

exercises.q: What does Elena want to do next year?
options: Get a job at the station.
exercises.explain: Она хочет организовать фотовыставку с друзьями.

sections.title: Аудирование
sections.script:
Waiter: Good evening, Rosa's Restaurant. How can I help you?
Tom: Hi. I'd like to book a table for Friday evening, please.
Waiter: Of course. For how many people?
Tom: For four. Two adults and two children.
Waiter: And what time would you like?
Tom: Is half past seven possible?
Waiter: I'm sorry, we're full at seven thirty. We have a table at eight o'clock.
Tom: Eight is fine. Oh, and could we sit near the window? My kids love watching the boats on the river.
Waiter: No problem. Can I have your name, please?
Tom: Tom Baker. B, A, K, E, R.
Waiter: Thank you, Mr Baker. And a phone number?
Tom: It's 07700 652 318.
Waiter: Great. See you on Friday at eight.

exercises.q: Which day is the booking for?
exercises.explain: Том бронирует столик на вечер пятницы (Friday evening).

exercises.q: How many people is the table for?
exercises.explain: Столик на четверых: двое взрослых и двое детей.

exercises.q: What time is the table booked for?
exercises.explain: На 7:30 мест нет, поэтому бронь на восемь часов.

exercises.q: Tom wants a table near the window.
exercises.explain: Том спрашивает: could we sit near the window?

exercises.q: Why does Tom want this table?
options: His children like watching the boats.
He wants to see the street.
exercises.explain: Его дети любят смотреть на лодки на реке.

title: B1 Practice Test 1
description: Тренировочный тест в формате экзамена уровня B1: грамматика, лексика, чтение и аудирование. Займёт около 45 минут.

exercises.q: Sorry, I can't come out tonight — I ___ my homework yet.
exercises.explain: Со словом yet в британском английском используется Present Perfect.

exercises.q: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.
exercises.explain: Прогноз на основе того, что мы видим сейчас, выражается через be going to.

exercises.q: This is ___ restaurant in our town.
exercises.explain: Превосходная степень с артиклем the: the best.

exercises.q: Tokyo is much ___ (big) than my home town.
exercises.explain: Сравнительная степень big — bigger (согласная удваивается).

exercises.q: If you ___ the 8:15 train, you'll be late for the meeting.
exercises.explain: В первом условном после if ставится Present Simple, а не will.

exercises.q: English ___ (speak) in many countries around the world.
exercises.explain: Пассив в Present Simple: is/are + третья форма глагола.

exercises.q: That's the shop ___ sells the best bread in town.
exercises.explain: Для предметов и мест в роли подлежащего придаточного используется which (или that).

exercises.q: I really enjoy ___ in the mountains.
exercises.explain: После enjoy глагол ставится в форму -ing.

exercises.q: We decided ___ a new car.
exercises.explain: После decide используется инфинитив с to.

exercises.q: You ___ smoke in the hospital. It isn't allowed.
exercises.explain: Mustn't — запрет; don't have to означает «не обязательно».

exercises.q: I ___ (walk) home when it started to rain.
exercises.explain: Действие, которое длилось в момент другого события, — Past Continuous.

exercises.q: This coffee is ___ hot to drink. Wait a few minutes.
exercises.explain: Too + прилагательное + to-инфинитив значит «слишком … чтобы».

exercises.q: Could you ___ me a favour?
exercises.explain: Устойчивое выражение: do somebody a favour — сделать одолжение.

exercises.q: Let's ___ a photo of the sunset.
exercises.explain: По-английски фотографируют глаголом take: take a photo.

exercises.q: He drives very ___ (care); he has never had an accident.
exercises.explain: Наречие от careful образуется с -ly: carefully.

exercises.q: I'm going to ___ up smoking. It's bad for my health.
exercises.explain: Give up — бросить (привычку).

exercises.q: The meeting has been ___ until next week.
exercises.explain: Put off — отложить, перенести на более позднее время.

exercises.q: Excuse me, how much does this jacket ___?
exercises.explain: Cost — стоить: How much does it cost?

exercises.q: She gave me some good ___ (advise) about my career.
exercises.explain: Advise — глагол, advice — существительное «совет».

exercises.q: I'd like to ___ a table for two for tonight.
exercises.explain: Book a table — забронировать столик.

exercises.q: He's very ___; he always tells the truth.
exercises.explain: Honest — честный, тот, кто говорит правду.

exercises.q: My brother is a ___ (science) and works in a laboratory.
exercises.explain: Профессия от science — scientist (учёный).

sections.title: Чтение
sections.text:
Three years ago, the empty piece of land behind Mill Street was a sad place. People threw rubbish there, and parents told their children not to play there because of the broken glass. Today it is one of the most popular places in the neighbourhood: a community garden full of vegetables, flowers and fruit trees.

The idea came from Sandra Lee, a retired nurse who has lived on Mill Street for over thirty years. 'I walked past that land every day and thought what a waste it was,' she says. 'So I knocked on my neighbours' doors and asked who wanted to help.' Only six people came to the first meeting, but they wrote to the local council and asked for permission to use the land. The council agreed, and it also gave the group a small amount of money to buy tools and seeds.

The first months were hard work. The volunteers spent every weekend clearing rubbish, and they found more than two hundred bottles in the soil. 'Some people laughed at us,' remembers Daniel Okafor, a student who joined the project in its first year. 'They said nothing would grow there. But in the summer we had our first tomatoes, and suddenly everyone wanted to be part of it.'

Now the garden has more than sixty members of all ages. Each family looks after a small area, but the fruit trees belong to everyone. Members don't pay to join, but they have to work in the garden for at least two hours a week. On the first Saturday of every month there is a market where members sell extra vegetables and homemade jam. The money goes towards new equipment and a water tank, because watering the garden in summer is expensive.

The garden has also changed the street in other ways. 'Before, I only knew the people who lived next door,' says Sandra. 'Now I know almost everybody, from the little children to the old men who come to play chess under the apple tree.' Next spring the group is planning to build a small greenhouse so that they can grow vegetables in winter too.

exercises.q: Before the garden existed, children often played on the land behind Mill Street.
exercises.explain: Родители запрещали детям играть там из-за битого стекла.

exercises.q: What was Sandra Lee's job before she retired?
exercises.explain: В тексте: a retired nurse — медсестра на пенсии.

exercises.q: What did the local council do?
options: It gave permission and some money.
It built a fence around the land.
It sent workers to clear the rubbish.
exercises.explain: Совет дал разрешение и немного денег на инструменты и семена.

exercises.q: The volunteers found a lot of bottles while they were cleaning the land.
exercises.explain: Они нашли в земле больше двухсот бутылок.

exercises.q: According to Daniel, what changed people's opinion of the project?
exercises.explain: Когда летом появились первые помидоры, все захотели участвовать.

exercises.q: Members pay a small fee every month to be part of the garden.
exercises.explain: Участники не платят, но должны работать в саду минимум два часа в неделю.

exercises.q: What is the money from the market used for?
options: new equipment and a water tank
exercises.explain: Деньги идут на новое оборудование и бак для воды.

exercises.q: What does the group plan to do next spring?
exercises.explain: Весной они планируют построить небольшую теплицу (greenhouse).

sections.title: Аудирование
sections.script:
Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the City History Museum. My name is Grace, and I'm going to tell you a few things before you start your visit.

The museum has three floors. On the ground floor you'll find the shop, the café and the cloakroom, where you can leave your coats and large bags. Please remember that bags bigger than a small backpack are not allowed in the exhibition rooms. The cloakroom is free, but you'll need a one-pound coin for the lockers, and you get the coin back when you open the locker.

On the first floor there's our most popular exhibition, Life by the River, which shows how people lived in the city two hundred years ago. Children love the old kitchen there, where they can try on clothes from that time. On the second floor there's a new exhibition about the history of football in the city. It opened only last week, so it may be quite busy this morning. If you prefer a quieter visit, I'd suggest starting at the top and walking down.

Free guided tours start at eleven o'clock and at two o'clock from the main entrance. Each tour lasts about forty-five minutes. If you'd like a tour in Spanish or French, please speak to someone at the information desk, because those tours have to be booked in advance.

You're welcome to take photos everywhere in the museum, but please don't use a flash in the Life by the River rooms, because it can damage the old paintings.

The café is open until half past four, and today there's a special offer: if you show your museum ticket, you get a free cake with any hot drink. The museum itself closes at five o'clock.

Enjoy your visit, and if you have any questions, just ask anyone wearing a green T-shirt.

exercises.q: Where is the cloakroom?
exercises.explain: Магазин, кафе и гардероб находятся на первом этаже (ground floor).

exercises.q: What do visitors need to use a locker?
options: a key from the information desk
exercises.explain: Для шкафчика нужна монета в один фунт, её потом возвращают.

exercises.q: What can children do in the old kitchen?
exercises.explain: Дети могут примерить одежду того времени.

exercises.q: The football exhibition opened last month.
exercises.explain: Выставка открылась только на прошлой неделе (last week).

exercises.q: Why does Grace suggest starting at the top of the building?
options: It will be a quieter visit.
exercises.explain: Она советует начать сверху, если хочется более спокойного посещения.

exercises.q: Tours in Spanish have to be booked in advance.
exercises.explain: Экскурсии на испанском и французском нужно бронировать заранее.

exercises.q: What is today's special offer in the café?
options: a free hot drink with any cake
a free cake with a hot drink if you show your ticket
a free sandwich after four o'clock
exercises.explain: При предъявлении билета к любому горячему напитку дают бесплатное пирожное.

title: B1 Practice Test 2
description: Тренировочный тест в формате экзамена уровня B1: грамматика, лексика, чтение и аудирование. Займёт около 45 минут.

exercises.q: If we lived near the sea, we ___ swimming every day.
exercises.explain: Второе условное (нереальная ситуация): if + Past Simple, would + глагол.

exercises.q: What would you do if you ___ (find) a wallet in the street?
exercises.explain: Во втором условном после if ставится Past Simple: found.

exercises.q: When we got to the cinema, the film ___.
exercises.explain: Фильм начался раньше, чем мы пришли, — Past Perfect.

exercises.q: 'I'm tired,' she said. → She said that she ___ tired.
exercises.explain: В косвенной речи после said время сдвигается назад: am → was.

exercises.q: Could you tell me ___?
exercises.explain: В косвенном вопросе порядок слов прямой: where the station is.

exercises.q: We ___ (wait) for the bus for forty minutes, and it still hasn't come!
exercises.explain: Действие началось в прошлом и продолжается сейчас — Present Perfect Continuous.

exercises.q: The Mona Lisa ___ (paint) by Leonardo da Vinci.
exercises.explain: Пассив в прошедшем времени: was + третья форма глагола.

exercises.q: It was ___ a beautiful day that we went to the beach.
exercises.explain: Перед a + прилагательное + существительное используется such.

exercises.q: Somebody is at the door. It ___ be Anna — she said she would come at six, and it's six now.
exercises.explain: Must выражает уверенное предположение: «это наверняка Анна».

exercises.q: There's very ___ milk left. Can you buy some?
exercises.explain: С неисчисляемыми существительными (milk) используется little.

exercises.q: The shop is closed ___ Christmas Day.
exercises.explain: С днями и датами используется предлог on.

exercises.q: I'd like to work as ___ engineer.
exercises.explain: Перед словом, начинающимся с гласного звука, ставится an.

exercises.q: Please ___ in this form with your name and address.
exercises.explain: Fill in a form — заполнить анкету.

exercises.q: I can't ___ to buy a new phone right now; it's too expensive.
exercises.explain: Can't afford — не могу себе позволить (по деньгам).

exercises.q: Air ___ (pollute) is a big problem in many cities.
exercises.explain: Существительное от pollute — pollution (загрязнение).

exercises.q: We ran ___ of petrol on the motorway.
exercises.explain: Run out of — закончиться (о запасах).

exercises.q: He ___ a lot of money on clothes every month.
exercises.explain: Spend money on something — тратить деньги на что-то.

exercises.q: I've ___ a cold, so I'm staying at home today.
exercises.explain: Catch a cold — простудиться.

exercises.q: It's ___ (possible) to finish this in one hour; we need at least three.
exercises.explain: Противоположное possible образуется приставкой im-: impossible.

exercises.q: The hotel staff were very ___ and answered all our questions.
exercises.explain: Helpful — готовый помочь (о людях); useful — полезный (о вещах).

exercises.q: I ___ my bus this morning, so I was late for work.
exercises.explain: Miss a bus — опоздать на автобус.

exercises.q: Her father is a famous ___ (journal) who writes for The Times.
exercises.explain: Профессия от journal — journalist (журналист).

sections.title: Чтение
sections.text:
When Lucas Moreau left school at sixteen, his teachers didn't expect much from him. He found most lessons boring, and his exam results were poor. 'The only subject I enjoyed was food technology,' he says, 'because I could use my hands and see a result at the end of the lesson.'

His first job was washing dishes in a busy hotel restaurant in Lyon. The work was hard and the hours were long, but Lucas watched the chefs carefully. After a few months the head chef, Marie Dubois, noticed that he often stayed after his shift to practise cutting vegetables. She offered him a place as a trainee cook. 'He wasn't the most talented person I'd ever worked with,' she remembers, 'but he was the most hard-working. He never complained, and he asked questions all the time.'

For the next five years Lucas worked in different kitchens in France and Spain. He also took evening classes in business, because he had a dream: to open his own restaurant. In 2021, at the age of twenty-four, he borrowed money from a bank and from his parents and opened a small restaurant with just twelve tables in his home town.

The first year was difficult. During the first winter there were evenings when only two or three customers came, and Lucas thought about closing. Then a food journalist visited by chance and wrote an article about his simple, seasonal dishes. After that, the restaurant was full almost every night.

Today Lucas's restaurant has a waiting list of three weeks. However, Lucas has not forgotten where he started. Every year he takes two young people who have left school without qualifications and trains them in his kitchen for free. 'School isn't the right place for everyone,' he says. 'Some people learn best by doing. I want to give them the chance that Marie gave me.'

He doesn't plan to open a second restaurant. 'A bigger business would mean less time in the kitchen,' he explains, 'and the kitchen is where I'm happiest.'

exercises.q: Lucas did very well in his school exams.
exercises.explain: В тексте сказано, что его результаты экзаменов были плохими (poor).

exercises.q: Why did Lucas enjoy food technology?
options: He could work with his hands and see a result.
His friends were in the same class.
exercises.explain: Он мог работать руками и видеть результат в конце урока.

exercises.q: What did Marie Dubois notice about Lucas?
options: He cooked better than the other chefs.
He often stayed after work to practise.
He wanted to become a head chef.
exercises.explain: Он часто оставался после смены, чтобы тренироваться резать овощи.

exercises.q: Marie thinks Lucas was the most talented cook she had ever worked with.
exercises.explain: Она говорит, что он был не самым талантливым, а самым трудолюбивым.

exercises.q: Why did Lucas take evening classes in business?
options: He wanted to open his own restaurant.
He wanted to become a journalist.
exercises.explain: Он мечтал открыть собственный ресторан.

exercises.q: What made the restaurant popular?
options: an article by a food journalist
exercises.explain: После статьи кулинарного журналиста ресторан стал полным почти каждый вечер.

exercises.q: Lucas trains some young people in his kitchen without asking them to pay.
exercises.explain: Каждый год он бесплатно (for free) обучает двух молодых людей.

exercises.q: Why doesn't Lucas want to open a second restaurant?
options: He wants to spend his time cooking.
exercises.explain: Большой бизнес означал бы меньше времени на кухне, где он счастливее всего.

sections.title: Аудирование
sections.script:
Mia: Hi, Ben. Have you got a minute? I want to talk about the camping trip next weekend.
Ben: Sure. Are we still going to the lake?
Mia: Well, that's the problem. I checked the weather forecast this morning, and it's going to rain at the lake all weekend. So I was thinking about the campsite near the coast instead. It should be dry and sunny there.
Ben: The coast? How far is that?
Mia: About three hours by car. The lake is only an hour and a half.
Ben: Hmm, that's quite a long drive. But I don't want to sleep in a wet tent. OK, let's go to the coast.
Mia: Great. My car is at the garage until Thursday, so can we use yours?
Ben: Yes, no problem. But it's small, so we can't take too much stuff. What about food? Should we buy it at the campsite?
Mia: The campsite has a small shop, but it's quite expensive. I think we should buy most of our food at the supermarket on Friday and cook on the camping stove.
Ben: Good idea. I'll do the shopping if you make a list.
Mia: Deal. And remember, you need to bring a warm sleeping bag. Even in summer it gets cold at night by the sea.
Ben: I haven't got a warm one. Mine is really thin.
Mia: You can borrow my brother's. He isn't using it this month.
Ben: Perfect. What time shall we leave on Saturday?
Mia: The campsite reception closes at six, so we need to arrive before that. How about leaving at eleven?
Ben: Could we make it twelve? I play football on Saturday mornings.
Mia: Twelve is fine. Three hours' drive, so we'll be there at about three. That's plenty of time.
Ben: Brilliant. I'll pick you up at your flat.

exercises.q: Why does Mia want to change the place for the trip?
options: The campsite at the lake is full.
The weather forecast for the lake is bad.
Their friends are at the coast.
exercises.explain: У озера все выходные будет дождь.

exercises.explain: Машина Мии в ремонте, поэтому поедут на машине Бена.

exercises.explain: Магазин в кемпинге дорогой, еду купят в супермаркете в пятницу.

exercises.q: What is Ben going to borrow?
exercises.explain: Бен возьмёт тёплый спальный мешок у брата Мии.

options: He plays football on Saturday mornings.
He has to do the shopping.
His car is at the garage.
exercises.explain: По субботам утром он играет в футбол.

exercises.explain: Бен говорит: I'll pick you up at your flat.

title: B1 Practice Test 3
description: Тренировочный тест в формате экзамена уровня B1: грамматика, лексика, чтение и аудирование. Займёт около 45 минут.

exercises.q: If you heat ice, it ___.
exercises.explain: Нулевое условное (общий факт): if + Present Simple, Present Simple.

exercises.q: I can't meet you on Friday — I ___ my grandparents. I've already bought the train tickets.
exercises.explain: Заранее договорённые планы на будущее выражаются через Present Continuous.

exercises.q: This is the hotel ___ we stayed last summer.
exercises.explain: Для места в значении «в котором» используется where.

exercises.q: That's the man ___ car was stolen.
exercises.explain: Whose означает принадлежность: «чья машина».

exercises.q: I ___ my hair cut yesterday at the new salon.
exercises.explain: Have something done — когда действие для вас выполняет кто-то другой.

exercises.q: Thank you for ___ (help) me with my homework.
exercises.explain: После предлога (for) глагол ставится в форму -ing.

exercises.q: ___ of my parents speaks English; they only speak Russian.
exercises.explain: Neither — «ни один из двух».

exercises.q: You look ill. You ___ see a doctor.
exercises.explain: Should используется для совета; ought требует to.

exercises.q: My parents ___ me stay out until midnight on Saturdays.
exercises.explain: Let + объект + глагол без to; allow и permit требуют to.

exercises.q: ___ the rain, we went for a walk.
exercises.explain: Despite + существительное — «несмотря на»; although требует целого предложения.

exercises.q: You won't pass the exam ___ you study harder.
exercises.explain: Unless означает «если не»: не сдашь, если не будешь заниматься больше.

exercises.q: The tickets can ___ (buy) online.
exercises.explain: Пассив с модальным глаголом: can + be + третья форма.

exercises.q: Don't forget to ___ your phone before the trip.
exercises.explain: Charge a phone — зарядить телефон.

exercises.q: I need to ___ some weight, so I've started going to the gym.
exercises.explain: Lose weight — похудеть.

exercises.q: Regular exercise is good for your ___ (healthy).
exercises.explain: Здесь нужно существительное: health — здоровье.

exercises.q: Can you ___ me up at the station at six?
exercises.explain: Pick somebody up — забрать кого-то (на машине).

exercises.q: I'm going to ___ for a job at the new library.
exercises.explain: Apply for a job — подать заявление на работу.

exercises.q: Can you turn the music ___? It's too loud and I'm trying to study.
exercises.explain: Turn down — сделать тише.

exercises.q: He's a very ___ (success) businessman with three companies.
exercises.explain: Прилагательное от success — successful (успешный).

exercises.q: I'm sorry, I didn't ___ to break your glass. It was an accident.
exercises.explain: Didn't mean to — не хотел, сделал не нарочно.

exercises.q: Swimming is a great way to ___ fit.
exercises.explain: Keep fit — поддерживать хорошую физическую форму.

exercises.q: There's a big ___ (different) between the two phones.
exercises.explain: Существительное от different — difference (разница).

sections.title: Чтение
sections.text:
Eighteen months ago, Hillside Secondary School made a decision that surprised many parents: students were no longer allowed to use their mobile phones during the school day. Now they have to put their phones in a locker when they arrive at 8:30 and can only take them out when lessons finish at 3:30.

Head teacher Mark Jennings says the idea came after a survey of the students themselves. 'Almost seventy per cent said that they felt tired and stressed because of social media,' he explains. 'Many said they couldn't stop checking their phones, even in lessons. We realised that we had to do something.'

Not everyone was happy at first. Some parents worried that they couldn't contact their children in an emergency. The school solved this problem by giving parents a phone number for the school office, which answers calls all day. A few students also complained loudly. 'I thought it was the worst rule ever,' says fifteen-year-old Chloe. 'For the first week I felt like something was missing. But then I started talking to people at lunch instead of looking at a screen. I've made new friends this year, and I don't think that would have happened before.'

Teachers say they have noticed changes too. Students concentrate better, and there are fewer arguments that start online and continue in the classroom. The school library, which used to be almost empty at lunchtime, is now so popular that the school has had to buy more chairs. Exam results have also improved slightly, although Mr Jennings says it is too early to know if the phone rule is the reason.

However, the rule has some critics. Technology expert Dr Sara Patel believes schools should teach young people to use phones sensibly rather than taking them away. 'When these students leave school, nobody will lock up their phones,' she says. 'They need to learn to control their own habits.'

The school agrees that this is important. Next year it plans to start weekly lessons about using technology in a healthy way, so that students are ready for life after school.

exercises.q: Students can use their phones during the lunch break.
exercises.explain: Телефоны можно забрать из шкафчика только после уроков, в 15:30.

exercises.q: What gave the school the idea for the rule?
exercises.explain: Идея появилась после опроса самих учеников.

exercises.q: How did the school deal with parents' worries about emergencies?
options: Students can keep phones in their bags.
Parents can call the school office at any time during the day.
Students can use a phone in the library.
exercises.explain: Родителям дали номер школьного офиса, который отвечает весь день.

exercises.q: Chloe liked the new rule from the very beginning.
exercises.explain: Сначала она считала это худшим правилом на свете.

exercises.q: What has been the main result of the rule for Chloe?
exercises.explain: Она начала общаться за обедом и завела новых друзей.

exercises.q: What has happened to the school library?
options: It is now closed at lunchtime.
It has become so popular that the school bought more chairs.
It has moved to a bigger room.
exercises.explain: Библиотека стала такой популярной, что пришлось купить больше стульев.

exercises.q: Mr Jennings is sure that the phone rule has improved exam results.
exercises.explain: Он говорит, что пока рано судить, связано ли это с правилом.

exercises.q: What is Dr Patel's opinion?
options: Phones should be banned in all schools.
Schools should teach students to use phones sensibly.
Parents should take away their children's phones.
exercises.explain: Она считает, что школа должна учить разумно пользоваться телефоном, а не забирать его.

sections.title: Аудирование
sections.script:
Receptionist: Good afternoon, Riverside Sports Centre. How can I help?
Daniel: Hi. I'm thinking of joining the centre, and I'd like some information about membership.
Receptionist: Of course. We have two types. The standard membership costs thirty-five pounds a month and includes the gym and the swimming pool. The premium membership is fifty pounds a month, and with that you can also go to all the fitness classes and use the sauna.
Daniel: I see. I'm mainly interested in swimming, to be honest. And maybe the gym sometimes.
Receptionist: Then standard is probably the best choice for you. Are you a student, by any chance?
Daniel: Yes, I'm at the college.
Receptionist: Great. Students get twenty per cent off, so you'd pay twenty-eight pounds a month. You just need to show your student card when you join.
Daniel: That's good news. What are the opening hours?
Receptionist: We're open from six in the morning to ten at night on weekdays, and from eight till eight at weekends. But the pool closes an hour earlier than the rest of the centre every day, because of cleaning.
Daniel: OK. And is the pool very busy?
Receptionist: It's busiest between five and seven in the evening, when people finish work. Early in the morning it's usually much quieter.
Daniel: Right. Do I need to bring anything when I join?
Receptionist: Just a photo for your membership card, or we can take one here, and your bank details for the monthly payment. Oh, and new members get a free session with a personal trainer in the first month. They'll show you how to use the gym machines safely.
Daniel: Sounds great. Can I come in tomorrow morning to sign up?
Receptionist: Of course. Tomorrow's Saturday, so we open at eight. Ask for Claire at the desk.
Daniel: Thanks very much.

exercises.q: What does the standard membership include?
options: the gym, the pool and fitness classes
exercises.explain: Стандартный абонемент включает спортзал и бассейн.

exercises.q: How much will Daniel pay each month?
exercises.explain: Студентам скидка 20%, поэтому 28 фунтов вместо 35.

exercises.q: What must Daniel show to get the discount?
exercises.explain: Для скидки нужно показать студенческий билет.

exercises.q: On weekdays the pool is open until ten at night.
exercises.explain: Бассейн закрывается на час раньше центра, то есть в девять вечера.

exercises.q: When is the pool usually quietest?
options: between five and seven in the evening
exercises.explain: Рано утром в бассейне обычно гораздо спокойнее.

exercises.q: New members get a free session with a personal trainer.
exercises.explain: В первый месяц новичкам положено бесплатное занятие с тренером.

exercises.q: When is Daniel going to the centre to join?
exercises.explain: Он придёт завтра утром, а завтра суббота.
